statement: There are n kinds of items. An item of kind i has weight weights[i] and value values[i], and you may pack as many items of each kind as you like.
A knapsack can carry a total weight of at most capacity.
Return the largest total value you can pack without going over capacity.

examples.explanation: Pack two items of weight 4 and one of weight 2: weight 10, value 11 + 11 + 5 = 27.
Two items of weight 3 fit (weight 6). A third would make 9, which is over 8.
